# React and Vite public task context

React uses ordinary TypeScript function components, props, children, JSX,
`useState`, `useEffect`, refs, native events, and keyed `.map()` collections.
The supplied Vite application already selects its directly addressable routes.
Build with `npm run build`. Prefer declarative TSX and native browser behavior;
do not add a router, state library, or other dependency for the requested
bounded feature.
